# onetsolutions_instance (Data Source)

Looks up a compute instance of a project by `id` or by `name`.

A lookup by name ignores cancelled and terminated instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_instance" "web" {
  name = "web-1"
}

output "web_ipv4" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_instance.web.primary_ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the instance. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) The hostname of the instance. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `billing_cycle` (String) The billing cycle of the instance.
- `created` (String) When the instance was created (RFC 3339).
- `image_id` (String) The UUID of the image the instance was installed from.
- `ip_addresses` (Attributes List) Every IP address of the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_addresses))
- `is_installed` (Boolean) Whether the operating system is installed.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether an operation in progress locks the instance.
- `next_billing_date` (String) The next renewal date (RFC 3339), null when none is scheduled.
- `os_name` (String) The name of the installed operating system.
- `primary_ipv4` (String) The primary public IPv4 address.
- `primary_ipv6` (String) The primary public IPv6 address, null when IPv6 is not enabled.
- `recurring_amount` (String) The amount billed at each renewal, excluding tax, as a decimal string.
- `size_id` (String) The UUID of the size of the instance.
- `state` (String) The power state last read: `running` or `stopped`, null while unknown.
- `status` (String) The status of the service: `pending`, `provisioning`, `active`, `suspended`, `terminated`, `cancelled` or `error`.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags of the instance.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The volumes of the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))
- `vpc_id` (String) The UUID of the VPC the instance joins, null when none.

<a id="nestedatt--ip_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The IP address.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the address.
- `ip_type` (String) `ipv4` or `ipv6`.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether it is the primary address of its family.
- `reverse_dns` (String) The reverse DNS name of the address, empty when unset.


<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `disk_type` (String) The disk type: `ssd`, `nvme` or `unknown`.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the volume.
- `name` (String) The name of the volume.
- `size_gb` (Number) The size of the volume in GB.
